name: stride-assets
description: Navigate Stride game engine asset files (.sd*) with go-to-definition, hover tooltips, broken link detection, and script navigation.

strideAssets.diagnosticsEnabled.markdownDescription: Show diagnostics (warnings/errors) for broken references in open asset files. Detects missing asset references, missing source files, and optionally missing script types.

strideAssets.scanWorkspaceForBrokenLinks.markdownDescription: Scan **all** asset files in the workspace for broken references on startup. This is useful for auditing a project but may be slow on large workspaces. When disabled, only open files are checked.

strideAssets.scriptNavigationEnabled.markdownDescription: Enable **script navigation**: Ctrl+click on script/component type references (e.g. `!MyNamespace.MyScript,MyProject`) to jump to the C# source file. Also adds hover tooltips and diagnostics for missing script types. Requires the [C#](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=ms-dotnettools.csharp) extension.

strideAssets.backLinksEnabled.markdownDescription: Enable **back-links**: scan all asset files to find which assets reference each other. Shows reference counts as CodeLens above `Id:` lines and in hover tooltips. Adds a workspace-wide file watcher for incremental updates. May increase memory usage on large projects.
